title: Claude's Multi-Platform App Gets a Major Upgrade: iPhone Version Officially Supports CarPlay Voice Interaction

content_html:
Recently, Anthropic officially posted multiple tweets on X, announcing a comprehensive and in-depth upgrade to its mobile app across multiple platforms. The most eye-catching development is that Claude's voice mode on iPhone has officially integrated with Apple's CarPlay system. This means users can now have smooth voice Q&A with Claude directly through their car's infotainment system while driving, bringing a brand-new intelligent experience to human-vehicle interaction.

In addition to the breakthrough in in-car scenarios, this multi-platform app upgrade also covers interface interaction, multi-account management, and a comprehensive expansion of language capabilities:

Interface layout and search optimization: The company previewed that a pull-down search feature will soon launch on iPhone and iPad, making it easier for users to quickly search historical conversations and related content. At the same time, on devices such as iPad and iPhone Duo, content generated by Claude will support side-by-side display with the chat window, and users can switch to full-screen viewing mode with one tap as needed, greatly improving reading and operation efficiency on large-screen devices.

Seamless account switching and foldable-screen adaptation: In terms of account management, the iOS and Android versions of Claude now support logging in to multiple accounts at the same time and switching directly between them. In addition, for large-screen and foldable-screen Android devices, the app experience has moved further toward the desktop experience, with multiple targeted adaptations added to make large-screen interaction more natural and smooth.

Multilingual and underlying voice upgrades: In terms of voice and globalization capabilities, Claude has achieved a major expansion across all platforms, adding support for 24 languages and bringing the total number of supported languages to 33. At the same time, voice mode responds faster, recognizes speech more accurately, and non-English voices sound more natural. Voice functionality also now covers more Android phones.

Industry analysts believe that with the intensive rollout of multi-platform coordination, in-car ecosystem integration, and global multilingual capabilities, Claude is accelerating its evolution from a single web-based AI assistant into a ubiquitous, all-scenario productivity tool.
